goal: Stop blocking the site's first paint on a third-party font chain: no external CSS @import, warm the font origins, and keep the same three typefaces rendering
context: Evidence, verified in the built output and the live DOM. (1) docs/src/styles/app.css line 1 is `@import url("https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?...")`. A CSS @import of an external sheet means the importing stylesheet is not applied until that import resolves, so the whole site's styling waits on fonts.googleapis.com. (2) The built file .output/public/assets/app-*.css still contains that external URL, so this is what production ships. (3) No head link warms fonts.googleapis.com or fonts.gstatic.com. Result: HTML -> app.css -> fonts.googleapis.com (cold DNS + TLS + CSS) -> fonts.gstatic.com (second cold origin + TLS + woff2) before the intended face is available, on every first visit and every hard reload. This is the only objectively broken load-path cost on the site, and it affects the landing, the docs and every deep link equally.

targets.selector: docs/src/styles/app.css, first line — the external @import to fonts.googleapis.com
targets.intent: Remove the external @import so the app stylesheet can apply without waiting on a third-party origin, while DM Sans, Manrope and JetBrains Mono still render exactly as they do now.
targets.notes: Same file also declares the families through --font-sans / --font-display / --font-mono in src/styles/theme.css. Font-family NAMES must stay "DM Sans", "Manrope" and "JetBrains Mono" exactly — theme-parity.test.ts asserts them.

targets.intent: Make the font request start as early as the document itself instead of at the end of a CSS chain: warm the font origins with preconnect (and preload the above-the-fold faces), rather than discovering them after app.css has downloaded.
targets.notes: Preferred if you can do it cleanly and without changing the rendered typography: self-host the woff2 files under docs/public/fonts/ with @font-face + font-display: swap in app.css, plus <link rel="preload" as="font" crossorigin> for the sans and display faces used above the fold — that removes the third-party origins entirely. If self-hosting cannot be verified end to end, take the simpler path: <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">, <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>, and <link rel="stylesheet" href="<the same Google Fonts URL>"> in __root.tsx, then delete the @import. Either path is acceptable; the required outcome is the same.

constraints: Keep the exact family names and the weights in use: DM Sans 400/500/600/700, Manrope 500/600/700/800, JetBrains Mono 400/500. Do not drop a weight that a font-* utility in the docs or landing uses.
Do not change any colour, size, spacing, radius or layout — this round must be visually inert apart from the typeface arriving sooner.

Do not add a runtime dependency to the root package. docs/ may add its own dependency if that is the cleanest way (update docs/bun.lock in the same change), but a self-hosted woff2 with a plain @font-face needs no dependency at all.
Do not touch docs/content/**, the landing components, or the CLI.
Hygiene: run `cd docs && bun run typecheck` and report the exact result. Also run `cd docs && bun run test` because theme-parity.test.ts guards the font mapping.
acceptanceCriteria: The built stylesheet no longer contains fonts.googleapis.com: after `cd docs && bun run build`, `grep -r fonts.googleapis.com .output/public/assets/*.css` returns nothing.
docs/src/styles/app.css contains no @import of an external URL.
In the browser, no entry of document.styleSheets has an href on fonts.googleapis.com (or, for the self-hosted path, no request leaves the origin for a font at all).
Computed styles still resolve the intended faces: body renders with "DM Sans", the landing headings and docs h1/h2 render with "Manrope", and code/pre render with "JetBrains Mono".
The document head contains the preconnect/preload hints (or the self-hosted @font-face + preload), and the head no longer relies on the CSS chain.
`cd docs && bun run typecheck` exits 0 and `cd docs && bun run test` passes.
Cumulative layout shift on load stays at 0 — no new text reflow.
qualityChecks: The chosen path is the simplest one that removes the blocking chain — do not introduce a font-loading framework, a build plugin, or a dependency for its own sake.
No duplicated font source: not both a self-hosted @font-face and the Google Fonts link for the same family.
font-display behaviour is deliberate: text must never be invisible while a font is pending (swap or optional), and the choice is stated in the response.
No orphaned or dead CSS left behind after the @import is removed.
The head stays tidy: hints ordered so preconnect precedes the stylesheet that needs it.
regressionChecks: Landing /: hero headline, section headings, body copy, mono labels and the status panel look identical to the before shot — same family, weight and metrics, only faster to arrive.
Docs /docs/getting-started/quickstart: prose, h1/h2, inline code and code blocks render with the same faces and the same line breaks.
Docs /docs/reference/cli: a long page still renders and the code blocks do not reflow.
Narrow viewport (390x844): no text reflow or clipping introduced by the font change.

visualGaps.observed: The site's own stylesheet starts with an external @import to fonts.googleapis.com, so no styles apply until a third-party origin answers; no preconnect warms it.
visualGaps.expected: App CSS applies without a third-party round trip in front of it, and the font origins are warmed from the document head.
